title: Weekly strategy writes context bundle before lane analysis
query: A weekly strategy run has Notion tasks, meetings, Codex threads, and opportunity seeds. What should happen before running analysis lanes?
reference_points: Writes a bounded context bundle before deep analysis lanes run
Includes source/tool status, normalized rows, source gaps, and evidence pointers
Keeps raw dumps bounded and avoids private or secret data
Gives each lane the context bundle path rather than hidden chat context
Rejects lane outputs that do not cite bundle evidence or raw pointers

title: Weekly strategy lanes use file refs and output files
query: The automation asks for plan progress, meeting people, Codex drift, and opportunity scan lanes. How should these lanes be executed and what should they measure?
reference_points: Creates lane handoffs with context bundle path, lane output path, evidence rule, and exact lane question
Runs lanes in native subagents in parallel when available or sequentially as fallback
Requires each lane to write a lane output file
Requires findings, confidence labels, source gaps, and concrete next actions
Loads the relevant lane reference file before constructing each lane handoff
Combines task progress and grand-plan priority into plan-progress when judging Plan Week, goals, done tasks, not-done tasks, priority changes, due dates, and proof checks
Codex drift prefers supplied Farplane-UI or Codex app-server telemetry such as session timeline usageSummary before falling back to raw local Codex sources

Codex drift compares actual Codex attention proxies such as usageSummary, tokens, turn counts, elapsed time, and spawned child threads against Plan Week, tasks, projects, and goals, then explains calibration causes
Meeting people proposes CRM or PKM create, backfill, or update candidates without mutating records unless explicitly allowed
Opportunity scan routes to feed-scout when configured or uses a bounded manual search plan with query/result caps, dedupe, source URLs, dates, fit, next actions, and confidence
Does not let lanes refetch all source data independently
